required_behavior: (a) to_worker kind work: nullable `commands` — ordered list of exact shell command strings written by the manager (each non-empty, no NUL, no env values per existing rules; sensible max count e.g. 32 and per-command max 8192 chars; fallbacks are just more entries). Strict schema (nullable optional), backend normalize/validate, stored in the Task spec/scope, rejected on experiment Tasks. Follow-up to_worker on the same Task may add/replace commands (define and document).

(b) Worker TASK message: when commands exist, show them numbered with an explicit rule: run them exactly as given with `terminal`, in order (use listed alternatives only as the procedure says), do not write or change commands, then report a summary of the results.

(c) Harness enforcement in flow_terminal: while the worker's active Task has commands, a `terminal` command must equal one of them exactly (compare as given; you may normalise only trailing whitespace/newline) else refuse with status not_in_task_commands (nothing typed) and the allowed list in the detail. No restriction when there is no active Task or the Task has no commands. command=null fetch unaffected.

(d) Auto-spill: a command whose RUN request would exceed the pipe limit is written by the harness to a temp script file (0700 dir/0600 file under the data dir terminal area, unique name, cleaned with the log retention) and run as `<shell> <file>`; the host pane shows `[worker] $ <first line of the command> … (script <path>)`; exit code/output semantics unchanged; replaces the (5)(b) command_too_long refusal for terminal (experiment run commands keep their creation/start checks unless trivially reusable — explain).

(e) to_manager done report: Workbench appends a machine-made 'Commands run' section from the journal for that Task (command (truncated for display), exit code/signal, duration, log path) so the worker need not repeat commands; update the worker skill: run the given commands as-is, never author new ones for a Task with commands, report a summary of results (values, failures), do not paste commands or scripts back.

(f) Manager skill (to-worker) + to_worker description: the manager writes the exact commands (and alternatives) in `commands`; the worker only runs them and summarises; keep `message` for goal/stop conditions/what to return.

(g) stuck-review-02 P3: experiment start-failure path keeps the hold until _give_back finishes (like terminal), and the `typing` flag is set right before actually typing (like terminal handoff_typed).
Tests red->green for each; real PersistentShell test for auto-spill (long multi-line script, exit code, output, pane line) and for enforcement (refused command types nothing).
acceptance: tests/backend, tests/bridge (py+node), tests/terminal, tests/workflow, tests/gates/g2_shell, tests/contracts, tests/ui (real exit codes); list independent tests needing updates (do not edit them)
rules: No real provider requests; never read credential contents or other processes' environ; never touch the user's tmux server or ~/wb-urux-sandbox and its processes; temp only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; no commits; no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first (real exit codes), status per item, design choices made, changed paths + sha256, independent tests needing updates. Korean, <=14 lines.
